# Coupling fields

*Generated by Claude.*

What WW3, MOM6 and CICE import in CESM, who supplies it, and the MESACLIP equivalent. Read from
the caps and `cmeps/mediator/esmFldsExchange_cesm_mod.F90` in `CESM_crocodash`.

**Needed:** {bdg-primary}`required` for useful physics · {bdg-secondary}`optional` (condition
given) · {bdg-light}`unused`. No cap aborts on a missing import except where noted; anything
unconnected is set to 0.

**MESACLIP:** {bdg-success}`yes` · {bdg-warning}`stand-in` (see
[compromises](mesaclip_cesm_modes.md#not-done-and-compromises)) · {bdg-info}`computed` by CMEPS ·
{bdg-danger}`missing` · {bdg-secondary}`other` source, not MESACLIP.

Ice and ocean variable names were checked in HIST member 010's daily files only.

## WW3

| Field | Meaning | From | Needed | MESACLIP |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Sa_u10m`, `Sa_v10m` | 10 m wind | atm | {bdg-primary}`required` | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `UBOT`, `VBOT` (`h2`), ~60 m winds |
| `So_u`, `So_v` | Surface current | ocn | {bdg-secondary}`optional` | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `U1_1`, `V1_1` (daily) × 0.01, grid-relative, on U points |
| `Sa_tbot` | Air temperature | atm | {bdg-light}`unused` CESM builds `STAB0` | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `TREFHT` (2 m) |
| `So_t` | SST | ocn | {bdg-light}`unused` as above | {bdg-success}`yes` `SST` (daily), °C → K |
| `So_bldepth` | Boundary-layer depth | ocn | {bdg-secondary}`optional` only if `HSLMODE=1` | {bdg-danger}`missing` POP saved `HMXL`/`XBLT`; DOCN sends 1e30 |
| `Si_ifrac` | Ice fraction | ice | {bdg-secondary}`optional` | {bdg-danger}`missing` `aice_d` (daily, %) ÷ 100; DICE deferred |
| `Si_thick` | Ice thickness | ice | {bdg-secondary}`optional` CICE only | {bdg-danger}`missing` `hi_d` ÷ (`aice_d`/100); DICE can't export it |
| `Si_floediam` | Floe diameter | ice | {bdg-secondary}`optional` CICE only | {bdg-danger}`missing` derive from concentration and thickness |

| WW3 export | Meaning | To |
|---|---|---|
| `Sw_lamult` | Langmuir enhancement factor | MOM6, if `WAVE_METHOD=EFACTOR` |
| `Sw_pstokes_x`, `Sw_pstokes_y` | Stokes drift in 3 bands | MOM6, if `WAVE_METHOD=SURFACE_BANDS` |
| `Sw_ustokes`, `Sw_vstokes`, `Sw_hstokes` | Surface Stokes drift and depth | ocean (MOM6 doesn't import them) |
| `Sw_elevation_spectrum` | Wave spectrum (25 frequencies) | CICE, if `wav_coupling_to_cice` |

- `wav_coupling_to_cice` is on only when `COMP_WAV=ww3` and `COMP_ICE=cice`
  (`cmeps/cime_config/buildnml`). Without CICE, WW3 ignores thickness and floe size and uses ice
  fraction only as a mask (cells ≥ 0.5).
- Fill values pass straight through: WW3 doesn't filter DOCN's 1e30.

## MOM6

MOM6 takes surface fluxes, not atmosphere state. CMEPS computes them from DATM's state and the
ocean's SST and currents, so MESACLIP's own fluxes (`TAUX`, `SHFLX`, `LHFLX`) are not used.

| Field | Meaning | From | Needed | MESACLIP |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Foxx_taux`, `Foxx_tauy` | Wind stress | CMEPS + ice | {bdg-primary}`required` | {bdg-info}`computed` from `UBOT`, `VBOT`, `ZBOT`, `TREFHT`, `QREFHT`, `PS` |
| `Foxx_sen`, `Foxx_evap` | Sensible heat, evaporation | CMEPS | {bdg-primary}`required` | {bdg-info}`computed` as above; 2 m T and q are placed at `ZBOT` |
| `Foxx_lwnet` | Net longwave | CMEPS | {bdg-primary}`required` | {bdg-info}`computed` `FLDS` + upward longwave from SST |
| `Foxx_swnet_*` | Net shortwave, 4 bands | CMEPS + ice | {bdg-primary}`required` | {bdg-info}`computed` from `SOLSD`, `SOLLD`, `FSDS` and ocean albedo |
| `Faxa_rain`, `Faxa_snow` | Rain, snow | atm | {bdg-primary}`required` | {bdg-success}`yes` `PRECT`, `PRECC`, `PRECSC`, `PRECSL` × 1000 |
| `Sa_pslv` | Sea-level pressure | atm | {bdg-primary}`required` | {bdg-success}`yes` `PSL` |
| `So_duu10n` | 10 m neutral wind squared | CMEPS | {bdg-secondary}`optional` | {bdg-info}`computed` |
| `Foxx_h{rain,snow,evap,cond}` | Heat content of water fluxes | CMEPS | {bdg-secondary}`optional` `cesm_coupled` | {bdg-info}`computed` |
| `Foxx_rofl`, `Foxx_rofi` (+ glacier, heat content) | Runoff | rof | {bdg-secondary}`optional` 0 without ROF | {bdg-secondary}`other` DROF (JRA, GLOFAS) |
| `Si_ifrac`, `Fioi_melth`, `Fioi_meltw`, `Fioi_salt` | Ice fraction, melt heat, meltwater, salt | ice | {bdg-primary}`required` with ice | {bdg-secondary}`other` CICE, or DICE `ssmi` |
| `Fioi_swpen*`, `Si_ifrac_n` | Shortwave through ice | ice | {bdg-secondary}`optional` | {bdg-secondary}`other` CICE |
| `Sw_lamult`, `Sw_pstokes_x/y` | Wave mixing | wav | {bdg-secondary}`optional` `WAVE_METHOD` | {bdg-secondary}`other` WW3 |
| `Faxa_ndep`, `Faxa_dst*`, `Faxa_bcph`, `Sa_co2*`, `Fioi_{flxdst,bcphi,bcpho}` | Deposition, CO₂ | atm, ice | {bdg-secondary}`optional` MARBL | {bdg-secondary}`other` DATM's prescribed streams |

| Atmosphere state CMEPS uses | MESACLIP |
|---|---|
| `Sa_u`, `Sa_v`, `Sa_z` | {bdg-success}`yes` `UBOT`, `VBOT`, `ZBOT` (`h2`) |
| `Sa_tbot`, `Sa_shum` | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `TREFHT`, `QREFHT` (2 m) |
| `Sa_ptem`, `Sa_dens` | {bdg-info}`computed` in DATM from `TREFHT`, `QREFHT`, `PS` |
| `Sa_pbot` | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `PS`; unused while `Sa_ptem` and `Sa_dens` are present |
| `Faxa_lwdn` | {bdg-success}`yes` `FLDS` (`h4`) |
| `Faxa_sw{v,n}{dr,df}` | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` diffuse `SOLSD`, `SOLLD`; direct `FSDS` minus diffuse, split 0.28 : 0.31 |

| MOM6 export | Meaning | To | MESACLIP DOCN |
|---|---|---|---|
| `So_omask` | Ocean mask | CMEPS, CICE | {bdg-success}`yes` |
| `So_t` | SST | CMEPS, CICE, WW3 | {bdg-success}`yes` `SST` |
| `So_u`, `So_v` | Current, east/north | CMEPS, CICE, WW3 | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `U1_1`, `V1_1`, grid-relative |
| `So_bldepth` | Boundary-layer depth | WW3 | {bdg-danger}`missing` fill value |
| `So_s` | SSS | CICE | {bdg-danger}`missing` POP `SSS` (daily, g/kg) exists |
| `So_dhdx`, `So_dhdy` | Sea-surface slope | CICE | {bdg-danger}`missing` from POP `SSH_2` gradient |
| `Fioo_q` | Freeze/melt potential | CICE | {bdg-danger}`missing` POP `QFLUX` (daily) exists |

- Shortwave streams are 6 h means with `tintalgo=nearest`, and CMEPS sets ocean albedo to 1 when
  the sun is down, so MOM6 loses the shortwave of any window that spans sunrise or sunset. Look at
  `tintalgo=coszen` or `CPL_ALBAV=TRUE` before MOM6 runs.
- Without an ice component, atmosphere fluxes are applied in full where sea ice should be.

## CICE

| Field | Meaning | From | Needed | MESACLIP |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Sa_u`, `Sa_v`, `Sa_z` | Lowest-level wind, height | atm | {bdg-primary}`required` | {bdg-success}`yes` `UBOT`, `VBOT`, `ZBOT` |
| `Sa_tbot`, `Sa_shum` | Air temperature, humidity | atm | {bdg-primary}`required` | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `TREFHT`, `QREFHT` (2 m) |
| `Sa_ptem` + `Sa_dens`, or `Sa_pbot` | Potential temperature, density | atm | {bdg-primary}`required` the only import CICE aborts without | {bdg-info}`computed` in DATM |
| `Faxa_sw{v,n}{dr,df}` | Downward shortwave, 4 bands | atm | {bdg-primary}`required` | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` as for MOM6 |
| `Faxa_lwdn` | Downward longwave | atm | {bdg-primary}`required` | {bdg-success}`yes` `FLDS` |
| `Faxa_rain`, `Faxa_snow` | Rain, snow | atm | {bdg-primary}`required` | {bdg-success}`yes` `PREC*` |
| `So_t`, `So_s` | SST, SSS | ocn | {bdg-primary}`required` | MOM6. DOCN: `SST` {bdg-success}`yes`, `So_s` {bdg-danger}`missing` |
| `So_u`, `So_v` | Current, east/north | ocn | {bdg-primary}`required` | MOM6. DOCN: {bdg-warning}`stand-in` grid-relative |
| `Fioo_q` | Freeze/melt potential | ocn | {bdg-primary}`required` | MOM6. DOCN: {bdg-danger}`missing` |
| `So_dhdx`, `So_dhdy` | Sea-surface slope | ocn | {bdg-secondary}`optional` tilt only | MOM6. DOCN: {bdg-danger}`missing` |
| `Faxa_bcph`, `Faxa_dst{wet,dry}` | Black carbon, dust | atm | {bdg-secondary}`optional` | {bdg-secondary}`other` DATM's prescribed aerosols |
| `Sw_elevation_spectrum` | Wave spectrum | wav | {bdg-secondary}`optional` `wav_coupling_to_cice` | {bdg-secondary}`other` WW3 |

| CICE export | To | DICE can supply? | MESACLIP |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Si_ifrac` | MOM6, WW3 | {bdg-success}`yes` | `aice_d` (%) ÷ 100 |
| `Si_thick` | WW3, with CICE only | {bdg-danger}`no` | `hi_d` (cell mean) ÷ (`aice_d`/100) |
| `Si_floediam` | WW3, with CICE only | {bdg-danger}`no` | none; CICE sends a fixed 50 m without floe-size distribution |
| `Fioi_melth`, `Fioi_meltw`, `Fioi_salt` | MOM6 | `ssmi` only | POP `MELTH_F`, `MELT_F`, `SALT_F` (daily) |
| `Fioi_taux`, `Fioi_tauy` | MOM6 | `ssmi` only | none (POP `TAUX`/`TAUY` are total stress) |
| `Fioi_swpen*` | MOM6 | `ssmi`, no bands | `fswthru_d` (daily, no bands) |

- Every other missing import is silently 0, so CICE forced by MESACLIP DOCN would get `So_s = 0`
  (freezing point near 0 °C) and no frazil growth.
- CICE assumes east/north vectors, so MESACLIP currents need rotating first.
